name: Direct Volume Rendering of LIC Textures
definition: A direct volume rendering method that uses multiple colour and transparency look-up tables to represent directional information of nerve fibre structures and other tissue types simultaneously. It uses an LIC texture and a probability map.
summary: Direct Volume Rendering of LIC Textures visualizes nerve fibers by combining Line Integral Convolution textures with probability maps, distinguishing itself by using both as dual inputs for transfer functions rather than rendering the texture alone.
